name: Sapphirus Hawthorne
source:
Sapphirus (called Sapphi by Alex) is Alex's staff officer. He has a rather cheery disposition, playing the role of teacher and care-taker of Alex, and holds amazing patience with Alex's stubborn attitude. Since he is trying to help Alex win the battle of succession, he takes on a rather rival-like relationship with Jade, Platina's staff officer. However, there is more to Sapphirus than meets the eye...
